summary: Iteration 8 — REAL end-to-end Stripe test purchase completed successfully. Verified full flow: paywall → Stripe hosted checkout → real card fill (4242 4242 4242 4242) → 'Pay and subscribe' click → redirect back to /payment/success → 'Welcome, dear friend.' + 'Your subscription is active.' → Continue → home shows access-pill-pro → new question does NOT trigger paywall → PRO persists across full page reload (backend /api/subscription/status resolves via app_user_id in localStorage).

issues: Stripe hosted checkout displays price as €5.45 (EUR with 21% VAT) instead of the advertised $4.99. Because Stripe geo-detects, this shows Netherlands + EUR by default. Users clicking Subscribe expecting $4.99 will see a higher local total. Consider fixing the Checkout Session locale/currency, forcing USD, or displaying region-aware pricing on the paywall.

action_items: Optional: Force Stripe Checkout Session currency to USD (or advertise EUR pricing on paywall) so displayed price matches the '$4.99/mo' shown in-app.
Consider adding data-testid='counsel-card' on generated counsel cards to make future counsel-generation assertions robust (current test verified only 'no paywall reopen' after Pro question).
critical_code_review_comments: Webhook-independent fallback in /api/payments/status worked correctly — poll returned paid within first cycle after redirect back, so 'Welcome, dear friend.' appeared at index 0. Good resilient design.
Home page correctly re-checks entitlement via useAccess on mount after Continue click — access-pill-pro rendered without manual refresh.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 fully validated the paid subscription flow end-to-end using real Stripe test card 4242. All 14 steps of the requested flow passed.
